digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI on GitHub Actions
propositions: Gerrit Verified latency increased from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes; mutation testing is not the direct cause but rather the combination of test expansion (+91,205 test lines, +4.1k selected tests), expensive real timeouts and sleeps in unit tests, and macOS process contention amplifying deterministic workload

Multiple unit tests execute expensive mechanics repeatedly or wait on production clocks unnecessarily: 120s JIRA readiness test, captured real sleeps in Jira capability and dependency audit paths, production 5xx backoff timings, repeated AST parsing, and per-xdist-worker wiki corpus recomputation

The 62-run post-mutation sample shows mutation contributed 0 seconds to critical path (never last prerequisite) and cannot explain regressions present in 57 skipped-mutation runs; active-mutation runs averaged 33.0m wall versus skipped-mutation runs averaging 36.5m

Remediation is decomposed into seven linked tickets addressing fake-clock injection for timeouts, late-bound sleep injection, immutable AST caching, per-process wiki corpus computation, import benchmark optimization, and fixture reuse, all preserving coverage and avoiding parallelism increases
Existing --durations=25 observability provided sufficient evidence; no new instrumentation was required
Current CI architecture cannot be improved by increasing macOS parallelism or runner-minutes without removing the accepted test coverage and xdist scope from prior completed tickets
